visual.general_description: Grayscale figure with two labelled screenshot panels of neurofeedback training displays: a feedback-run screen (a) and a transfer-run screen (b).
visual.detailed_description: Panel a shows the feedback display with two rows of arrows in bars, instruction text, two small bar graphs and large numerals; panel b shows the transfer display with a cartoon sun, two round icons and two instruction lines. Both are interface screenshots without patient identifiers.

panels.general_description: Grayscale screenshot of a feedback-run training screen: two rows of tall bars holding arrows, a cartoon sun, instruction text and two small bar graphs with large numerals.
panels.detailed_description: A grayscale training screen. At top left the text "Threshold Success!" sits above a grey cartoon sun wearing sunglasses, with the small text "0.00" to its right. Three dark glossy round icons are shown: one right of the sun with no label, one below left labelled "Breath" and one below right labelled "Eyes". An upper row of 16 tall rectangular bars each holds a grey upward-pointing arrow at a different height, with small numeric labels beneath each bar that are only partly legible at this resolution. Under the row are the texts "Higher Pitched Tone - ACTIVATE your Brain - KEEP the red arrows going up!" and "Entire Trial SUCCESS - Bar Graph below moves to RIGHT and color is GREEN", a small horizontal bar graph titled "Activation Total Amplitude" with axis labels 40, 20, 0, -20, -40 and a grey bar, and the large grey numeral "-23.26". A lower row of 16 bars holds grey downward-pointing arrows near the top of each bar with small numeric labels beneath, again partly legible. Under it are "Lower Pitched Tone - Quiet your Brain - KEEP the blue arrows going DOWN...", "Entire Trial SUCCESS - Bar Graph below moves to LEFT and color is GREEN", a small bar graph titled "Inhibit Total Amplitude" with axis labels 40, 20, 0, -20, -40 and a dark bar, and the large dark numeral "18.02". At the far left is a tall empty rectangle with a grey double-headed vertical arrow and a horizontal line at mid height.

panels.general_description: Grayscale line chart titled FEEDBACK TRIALS with three block sub-plots of daily mean SCP amplitude for positive and negative trials, separated by BREAK and 1 MONTH bands.
panels.detailed_description: Title "FEEDBACK TRIALS" with sub-plot headings "BLOCK 1", "BLOCK 2" and "BLOCK 3". The y-axis reads "MEAN SCP AMPLITUDE [uV]" with ticks 40 down to -50 in steps of 10, and each block has an x-axis of days 1 to 10 with "DAY" at the far right; a horizontal zero line crosses each block. Narrow vertical bands between the blocks read "BREAK" and "1 MONTH". The legend shows a square marker for "POSITIVE SCP TRIALS" and a circle marker for "NEGATIVE SCP TRIALS". Block 1 has both series on days 1 to 10: the positive series rises irregularly and ends above the zero line on day 10, and the negative series stays well below the positive series with a local rise on day 4. Block 2 has points on days 1 and 3 to 8 only, with a faint grey connecting segment between day 1 and day 3; both series rise toward the right, the positive series ending far above the zero line on day 8.  Block 3 has points on days 2 to 8 only; the positive series peaks on day 4 above the zero line and ends slightly above it on day 8, and the negative series stays below zero and rises overall.
